notes: The parts are the same as in step 1; step 1 was correct.
The schematic shows pin 2, but the circuit text and image use pin 4, so I used pin 4.

The image's upper half is labelled f-j and the lower half a-e. I mapped the upper half to bank 'b' and the lower half to bank 't'. The bottom rail pair is 'bn' (ground, the upper row of the pair) and 'bp' (+5V, the lower row).
The button sits across the centre gap in columns 6 and 8. Column 6 is side 1 (pin 4 side) and column 8 is side 2 (5V side). Pressing the button joins them.

Pin 4 reaches the button through the blue wire at 6t.c. The 10k pull-down resistor goes from 6t.a to the ground rail. The short red wire runs from 8t.c to the + rail, which is fed 5V by the long red wire.
Exact breadboard hole numbers on the rails are read from the image. Any hole of a rail strip is electrically equivalent.
The ground wire goes to the first GND pin next to 5V (GND.1).
